settings.heading: Cleaning up the shower shelf.
settings.lede: Most grooming products are a list of things you cannot pronounce. We wanted a bar of soap you could explain to your grandfather.
settings.image_alt: A bearded man holding a stack of soap bars
A man washing his face at a mountain stream
settings.heading: Personal care got complicated for no good reason.
settings.text: Walk down any aisle and half the labels read like a chemistry exam. We think a daily wash should use ingredients you trust, smell like somewhere you would rather be and cost about the same as a coffee.

settings.quote: “I started with a stockpot, a few oils and a stubborn idea that soap could smell like the outdoors.”
